title: My House and My Dog
text:
This is my house. It is small and blue. It has two windows and a red door. There is a big garden behind it.

My dog is called Max. He is brown and very friendly. He likes to run in the garden. In the evening, he sleeps near the door.

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about Max?
options: The writer is afraid of Max
The writer does not know Max
The writer wants to sell Max

questions.text: Where does Max probably spend most of his day?

vocabulary.definition: a piece of land next to a house where plants and flowers grow
an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
kind and nice to other people

paragraph_translations: Bu benim evim. Küçük ve mavi. İki penceresi ve kırmızı bir kapısı var. Arkasında büyük bir bahçe var.
Köpeğimin adı Max. Kahverengi ve çok arkadaş canlısı. Bahçede koşmayı sever. Akşamları kapının yanında uyur.
